text:
lina: Quick follow-up from the DB cluster postmortem. We discovered this is a recurring monthly spike pattern. Need: clear owners per action, one-line AC, ISO due dates, and a short owner rotation plan for long-term monitoring. Reply like: Owner | AC | ETA | Jira. Keep it tight.

omar: I'll take the "fix query fanout" work and a lightweight regression test. AC: query path de-duplicated + regression tests added. ETA: 2026-04-10. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-11210

carmen: I'll own alert tuning to differentiate transient vs sustained spikes. AC: alert noise reduced by 80% and new sustained-spike signal added. ETA: 2026-04-08. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-11211

evan: I'll own the recurrence analysis task (run historical anomaly checks and add to runbook). AC: recurrence report + mitigation recommendations attached. ETA: 2026-04-12. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-11212

maya: I'll own the owners-rotation policy doc so SRE oncall rotates monthly and we have a documented handoff. AC: rotation doc + onboarding checklist for owners. ETA: 2026-04-15. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-11213

lina: Nice. Please also add RACI in the postmortem doc: R=owner, A=postmortem lead (me), C=peer reviewers, I=oncall rotation.

omar: created RDW-11210 and pushed a tiny PR branch. Moving to In Progress once tests are green.

carmen: RDW-11211 created; adding a sample alert rule diff. Planning to reduce pager noise and add a suppressed window for deploy flappers.

evan: RDW-11212 created and I attached a quick adhoc query with results. Finding: pattern peaks ~1st week of month correlated with batch jobs. Recommending backpressure on batch consumers as option.

maya: RDW-11213 created; included a weekly handoff checklist and a short owner onboarding doc. Setting rotation start 2026-05-01.

lina: Acceptance criteria summary to paste in tickets: 1) concrete fix or mitigation implemented, 2) tests covering regression, 3) alerts tuned with reduced false positives, 4) owners table updated + rotation policy in doc, 5) recurrence analysis attached.

omar: Adding that AC to RDW-11210. PR checklist I'll put in the ticket description:

```
- [ ] fix merged
- [ ] regression tests
- [ ] perf smoke if relevant
- [ ] postmortem doc updated with tickets/RACI
- [ ] rotation policy linked
```

carmen: I also propose adding a small "rapid mitigation" runbook for oncall (one-liner to suspend the offending consumer) so we can act fast on recurrence. I'll draft RDW-11214 and link it.

evan: good idea. RDW-11214 created by carmen for the runbook. ETA: 2026-04-07.

maya: I'll include the runbook reference in the rotation onboarding so new owners know who to call and how to execute.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-11211 (carmen) due in 1 day.

lina: One more ask: please add ISO dates in the postmortem Owners table and mark high priority if the ticket blocks ongoing stability. I'll review in the next planning slot and close the loop.

omar: Done — updated doc with RACI and ISO due dates. tagging @carmen for alert diffs. :thumbsup:

carmen: Linked alert diffs and set RDW-11211 priority to high because noise is masking real alerts.

evan: Updated RDW-11212 with the recurrence notebook and recommended mitigation options.

maya: Finalized rotation schedule in RDW-11213. First owner: omar, backup: carmen.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-11210 (omar) and RDW-11214 (carmen) marked high priority by lina.

lina: Thanks all  I'll paste this thread into the postmortem actions section and set a verification checkpoint after work completes. If anything slips, escalate in #postmortems. Closing after QA sign-off. :wave:
